sentences.text: Felicity Rose Hadley Jones -LRB- born 17 October 1983 -RRB- is an English actress .
She started her professional acting career as a child , appearing at age 12 in The Treasure Seekers -LRB- 1996 -RRB- .	The Treasure Seekers	The Treasure Seekers (1996 film)

Jones went on to play Ethel Hallow for one season in the television show The Worst Witch and its sequel Weirdsister College .	Ethel Hallow	Ethel Hallow	The Worst Witch	The Worst Witch (1998 TV series)	Weirdsister College	Weirdsister College

She took time off from acting to attend university at Wadham College , Oxford where she performed in Shakespeare 's The Comedy of Errors for the Oxford University Dramatic Society , and has worked steadily since graduating in 2006 .	Wadham College	Wadham College, Oxford	Oxford	University of Oxford	Shakespeare	Shakespeare	The Comedy of Errors	The Comedy of Errors	Oxford University Dramatic Society	Oxford University Dramatic Society
On radio , she has played the role of Emma Grundy in the BBC 's The Archers .	BBC	BBC	The Archers	The Archers
In 2008 , she appeared in the Donmar Warehouse production of The Chalk Garden .	Donmar Warehouse	Donmar Warehouse	The Chalk Garden	The Chalk Garden

Since 2006 , Jones has appeared in numerous films , including Northanger Abbey -LRB- 2007 -RRB- , Brideshead Revisited -LRB- 2008 -RRB- , Chéri -LRB- 2009 -RRB- , and The Tempest -LRB- 2010 -RRB- .	Northanger Abbey	Northanger Abbey (2007 film)	Brideshead Revisited	Brideshead Revisited (film)	Chéri	Chéri (film)	The Tempest	The Tempest (2010 film)

Her performance in the 2011 film Like Crazy was met with critical acclaim , garnering her numerous awards , including a special jury prize at the 2011 Sundance Film Festival .	Like Crazy	Like Crazy (2011 film)	2011 Sundance Film Festival	2011 Sundance Film Festival
